The '''Drogheda Royal Guard''' were the armed forces on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drogheda/Legends|Drogheda]], who served the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchy]]. The guards were equipped with [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapons as well as distinctive helmets that covered the majority of their heads, and often used [[sky-sled]]s to traverse the rugged landscape of Drogheda. During the planet's [[Drogheda Civil War|civil war]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the royal guard was the primary force employed by [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Sarna (Queen)|Sarna]] to combat a [[Drogheda Revolutionaries|popular revolutionary front]] that aimed to overthrow the monarchy and replace it with a [[Democracy/Legends|democratic]] government. However, the group was much more loyal to their commander, [[Harlech]], and during the conclusion of the civil war, Harlech attempted to usurp the Queen's power and declare himself [[King/Legends|King]]. The revolutionaries were able to storm the [[Drogheda Citadel]] before he could seize power, preventing the coup. The majority of Harlech's men surrendered, and although Harlech decided to fight to the end, he was quickly [[Stun/Legends|stunned]] and prevented from any sort of heroic last stand.<ref name="marvel83" />
